top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the most complete and mature achievement on the shortlist: proglucagon processing and identification of the active GLP-1 peptides, human incretin physiology and mechanisms of action in islets, brain and gut, and therapies whose benefit in glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes is confirmed in independent randomized trials. A three-person allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) with a citation on the physiology of GLP-1 and its active forms is defensible, though Habener's claim and the contested priority of Mojsov remain imperfections. These do not justify no award.
